Attached: 1 image

Its been a week! I finally wrote up a thing about DjangoCon US.

Third year chairing volunteers, first time ever getting all five @djangonaut@indieweb.social  founders in one place 🚀 , one karaoke room I refused to leave, and a few conversations that reminded me how much people here actually care. 🫶

Inspired, motivated, and very very tired. 😅

https://www.rachellcalhoun.com/post/i-think-that-feeling-is-called-hope/

#DjangoConUS #Django #Python #OpenSource
